notes.title: Welcome on board, agent! It's time to interrogate 🕵️‍♂️
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the game is now released! Don't miss your opportunity to face and investigate the most dangerous female outlaws in all the galaxy - they've got their important secrets, and they're not giving them up, unless for now.

"But what if I'm not really up to interrogating them and want to take their side?", you might ask. Well, then do what you feel is the right thing to do and help them escape! Get to know the staff you're working with, the imprisoned girls, get their secrets out or help them flee all while having numerous hot encounters - who are you going to explore deeper? Find out now!

notes.title: Are you ready to face the femme fatales? 🔞
notes.content:
Game offers you the chance to decide on the fates of a few highly dangerous female outlaws held in prison located on a spaceship - pry out their secrets playing as a former special agent. The truth you're after can save lives! Or ruin them...

Everything depends on your decisions and skills - you shape the destinies and outcomes of the story here. Aid Lilith's escape, find out what Selena's weapon secrets are or become the one to decode R127's encrypted information - you'll be facing moral dilemmas and planning escapes while navigating through intense and intricately built dialogues.

[h2]Futuristic setting, diverse adult content, incredible 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay await this Saturday![/h2]

[h3]Consider joining one of the first, and you may find a little bonus...🎁[/h3]

[b]Are you ready to make the right choices? 🤔[/b]
